claims: County Road 519 from the Wakefield side remains the official alternative to reach Presque Isle during the park's winter M-107 and South Boundary Road closures.
Some park roads close starting December 1 through late spring and reopen when the road commission determines them safe.

officialRoadFunding.note: 2026 state grant announcement describes County Road 519 N pavement in poor condition (2/10) and future rehabilitation. Funding approval is not evidence construction or closure has begun.

stateRoadGIS.note: MGF centerline naming in this envelope does not use 519. Do not equate these IDs one-for-one with the signed County Road 519 or claim a complete drive from US-28 to a parking stall.

routeRules.fromWestDuringWinter: DNR-authorized west-side approach identified, subject to current posted closures and parking
